description: `directives show <name>` (cli.py's cmd_directives, via `commands::directives::run`) refuses outright when every positional project token fails to match a configured project by name or path (`select_projects` in `directives.rs` returns empty) — distinct from the tty refusal (`directives-set-refuses-noninteractive.json`) and the clean read/no-file case (`directives-show-reads-standing-directive.json`). `show` is used here rather than `set` so the refusal under test is reached directly, without first tripping `set`'s own interactive-terminal check.
